title: Stop Saying "Very Scared"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very scared". Try one of these instead:
• Terrified: terrified of spiders
• Petrified: petrified when the lights went out
• Horrified: horrified by the accident
• Panic-stricken: a panic-stricken crowd
• Scared stiff: scared stiff during a horror film

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
